title: EDC 2011 VEGAS.m4v
description: EDC moved its yearly Cali event to Sunny Las Vegas, NV at the Motor Speedway. The 3 day event was more than amazing. It was truly an unforgettable and very magical weekend that I will never forget. Tiff X and the Creator crew show their crazy experience with guest appearances and performances from Laidback Luke, Tiesto, Swedish House Mafia, Donald Glaude, Scottyboy & more. Watch now, its a must see.
